stories.title: Forecast: A few light showers Tuesday; freeze for the Hill Country Wednesday AM
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: 1 juvenile injured in East Austin shooting
stories.summary: Austin police said two other juveniles, as well as an adult were detained following the shooting.

stories.title: North Austin shop asks community to help support local makers this holiday season
stories.summary: Parker + Scott General Store is hoping to make 3,439 sales by New Year's Eve to help keep its business, and the local vendors it supports, running smoothly in 2027.

stories.title: Texas flood survivors had to wait more than 100 days to apply for FEMA aid. Now they want change.
stories.summary: More than four months after July's devastating floods, families are still displaced as Texas prepares for a transition in state leadership.

stories.title: Child dies after being hit by vehicle in southeast Austin
stories.summary: The incident occurred on East Riverside Drive between South Pleasant Valley Road and Wickersham Lane at around 4:30 p.m. Monday.

stories.title: Travis County’s ICE agreement draws pushback from community members, faith leaders
stories.summary: The 287(g) agreement is required under a state law passed last year, with sheriff’s offices facing a Dec. 1 deadline to sign.

stories.title: Paxton drops suits against two Texas doctors over transgender care as he prepares to leave office
stories.summary: Brett Cooper and May Lau were among the three doctors Paxton accused of violating Texas’ 2023 ban on gender-transition care for minors.

stories.title: SAPD: 3 arrested in connection to 2020 robbery, fatal beating of 25-year-old man
stories.summary: Jacinto Martinez, Mark Talamantez and Elijah Rodriguez have all been arrested for the murder of Shawn Gaitan more than six years later, officials say.

stories.title: Mexico demands SpaceX clean up suspected rocket debris washing ashore near Texas
stories.summary: Suspected debris from a SpaceX rocket explosion has washed up in Mexico, prompting cleanup efforts and new questions about environmental risks near Texas.

stories.title: Beloved Houston couple found dead in house fire days before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Calvin Richard Jr., 81, and his wife, Arlene, 65, were found dead in a Houston house fire on Monday. Their family is grieving days before Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Central Texas Food Bank spending 50% more on Thanksgiving turkeys as food needs grow
stories.summary: The food bank plans to distribute 22,000 turkeys this Thanksgiving, while nearly 600,000 people across its 21-county service area struggle to afford food.

stories.title: City of Taylor receives $1.1M from Samsung for park renovations, public safety improvements
stories.summary: The funds will go toward improvements at Robinson Park and Murphy Park, as well as a new hazmat response trailer for the Taylor Fire Department.
